oh dear....
Has the material there moved? What was there? I believe a lot of Grothendieck's writings were taken down at his request.
That was a long time ago. There was a lot of other good material there last time I looked, and even some of Grothendieck's stuff was actually still there but not linked.

I'm old, it feels like last week to me.

Seriously, where do people go for all their EGA and SGA needs these days? The Russian websites, or something more specific?

Check this, and this.
They are not updated, but still online.
Great - all of SGA, it seems, or at least a lot! Thanks!

My paper on Grothendieck's Vietnamese student made use of Grothendieck's interesting 1967 report on his visit to Hanoi, which was on the Grothendieck Circle website, now preserved here:

  • Mathematical Life in the Democratic Republic of Vietnam.
